## Screenshot boundary and license

[Command/security contract](../runtime/screenshot.md). Fixed no-argument sudo helper
checks readiness/runtime account, discovers active vc4 display, reads an exported
scanout and closes DRM/GEM/PRIME resources. It permanently drops groups, all UID/GID
privileges and capabilities before PNG encoding. The ordinary wrapper owns output.
No arbitrary path/device/command, DRM master acquisition, modesetting, framebuffer
write, VT switching, broad capability or fbdev fallback. General sudo use_pty stays
unchanged; only the fixed capture helper has the binary-stdout exception.

GPL-2.0-only `project-cbm-kms-capture` remains separately packaged. Technical starting
point: pcercuei/kmsgrab `d4c6061a59f4b7ecb6b39f96c7d39a5d5f48b702`; corresponding source,
upstream reference, license/notices retained. MIT Runtime stays separate. Reuses
libdrm/libpng/zlib/libcap; no full FFmpeg or aria2 installation. Helper 67,744 bytes.
No tear-free moving-frame guarantee; unsupported/ambiguous composition fails clearly.
